C1478.title: Amitabh Bachchan Injunction Over Unauthorized Commercial Use of Personality Rights
C1478.summary: Indian actor Amitabh Bachchan sued Rajat Nagi and other defendants in the Delhi High Court after websites, applications, and merchandise sellers allegedly used his name, likeness, voice, and other personality attributes without authorization. On November 25, 2022, the court issued an ex parte interim injunction barring unauthorized commercial use of those attributes and directed relevant online intermediaries to help restrict the infringing material.
